time.listening: About 30 minutes · audio plays once · 2 minutes to check
time.writing: 60 minutes · Task 1 (150 words) and Task 2 (250 words)

listening: The recording plays once; you cannot pause or rewind.
Type answers directly; move between parts with the bar at the bottom.
When the audio ends you have 2 minutes to check, then the test is submitted.
reading: Drag the middle bar to resize the panes.
Select text in the passage to highlight it; click a highlight to remove it.
Tick Review for questions to come back to. The test is submitted when time is up.
writing: Task 2 counts twice as much as Task 1.
The word count is under the box. There is no spell check.
After submitting, AI gives a band for the 4 criteria.

import.intro: The PDF is read in your browser: text, a picture of each page, and OCR of scanned pages. The server only receives small page images; then AI splits it into tests, questions and answers.

import.localOcrHint: Free and no server load, but slower (a few seconds per page). Pages it cannot read are read by AI from the picture (needs a vision model). Unticked: the server reads them after the upload. Only pages it cannot read well go to AI (needs a vision model).

chunks.hiddenHint: Listen to the whole piece first, then show the text to check. Tap words to look them up.

edit.heading: Review recording
edit.intro: Listen to each sentence, fix words, move start/end by 0.25 s, join or split. Yellow ones are where the machine was unsure.
edit.title: Title
edit.shiftHint: When every sentence starts equally early or late.
edit.autoCaptions: YouTube's automatic captions: some words may be wrong and sentences cut oddly.
edit.speaker: Speaker
edit.cleanHint: Removes sound tags ((Applause), [Music], ♪…, Q31), moves speaker labels ("Chris Anderson:", "CA:", or "JOHN" in capitals at the start or end of a sentence) to the speaker field, joins very short sentences to a neighbour. Nothing is cut, so times stay.
edit.cleaned: Removed {tags} sound tags and {labels} speaker labels, joined {joined} short sentences, dropped {removed} empty ones. Save to keep it.
edit.aiCleanHint: AI removes tags and speaker labels, joins lines into whole sentences (under ~25 words, 8 s) and names speakers. It may not change words: a sentence where it did gets the rule-based clean-up. Times stay.
edit.aiFailed: AI could not do it now (check the AI settings); try again or use Clean up.
edit.aiCleaned: AI: {before} lines → {after} sentences. {fixed} sentences had changed words (rule-based text kept), {fallback} pieces done without AI. Save to keep it.
edit.strikePlaceholder: Words to remove, comma-separated: JOHN, MARY
edit.strikeHint: Removes the typed words or phrases from every sentence: whole words only, same capitals ("JOHN" does not remove "John").
edit.struck: Removed {n} places. Press Save to keep it.

ielts.redoConfirm: This part is already in the bank. Cutting it again resets its practice history. Continue?
ielts.noScript: An audioscript is needed for the listening bank.
ielts.hint: The server listens to the audio (Whisper) to time each audioscript sentence. Runs in the background: you can close the page.
ielts.cancelConfirm: Stop adding these parts to the bank?
ielts.problem: The last run had a problem{parts, plural, =0 {} other { in # parts}}: {error}

errors.ffmpeg_missing: ffmpeg is not installed on the server. Install it: apt install ffmpeg (or aaPanel → App Store), then try again.
errors.no_audio: The part's audio file was not found.
errors.nothing_heard: No speech heard in the audio (check the part's start and end times).
errors.out_of_memory: The server ran out of memory during speech recognition (it needs about 1 GB free). Stop other services or add RAM / swap, then try again.
errors.interrupted: The job was cut off several times (worker restarted). Check: pm2 logs gainee-worker.
errors.speech_bad_output: Speech recognition gave a broken result, try again.

listen.ieltsPartsHint: Press "Add to listening bank" on a part, or "Add the whole book". The server listens to the audio to time each sentence (in the background, you can close the page); then the part gets its practice button and appears in the list above.
listen.draftsToReview: {n} recordings not reviewed: listen and fix them before practice
listen.practiceHint: Tip: review due sentences first, then random practice. To go through a whole video in order, open it in Recordings.

addSteps.title: Steps
addSteps.one: Paste a YouTube link with English captions (or paste the transcript if they cannot be fetched).
addSteps.two: On the review screen: Clean up (or Clean up with AI), listen to a few sentences, fix cuts, then Save & mark reviewed.
addSteps.three: Practise: the whole video in order, listen in pieces, or random practice from the bank.

listen.lookupHint: Tap a word (or select a few) in a shown sentence to look it up, ask AI and save it to your notebook. The result shows here.
listen.resize: Drag to resize the column (double-click: default)

roleHint.editor: A learner who can also import IELTS books and check the listening bank.

admin.featuresHint: By default from this user's groups, then the role. Choose On/Off to set it for this user.

pricing.ratesHint: Credits per 1 million tokens the AI reads in and writes out. Models without their own price use the default.
pricing.packagesHint: Learners pick a package and pay by bank transfer; press "Payment received" under Top-ups to add the credits.
pricing.payInfoHint: e.g. Bank transfer to … with the request code in the note.

pricing.customHint: The minimum {min} ₫ gives {credits} credits. Discount codes work on own amounts too.

groups.hint: Groups decide which shared texts learners see (set on the text's page) and can switch features for all members. In several groups, one group allowing a feature is enough. A user's own switch wins.
groups.newName: New group name, e.g. IELTS 6.5 Tuesday class
groups.name: Group name
groups.deleteConfirm: Delete the group "{name}"? Its learners are kept, they only leave it.

admin.logoutAllConfirm: Log this user out on every device?

security.aiHint: Admins are not limited. 0 = no limit.
security.maxInput: Characters sent to the AI per call
security.captchaHint: Create a free widget at dash.cloudflare.com → Turnstile, add the site's domain, then paste the Site key and Secret key here.
security.captchaOn: Require a captcha to sign up
security.needKeys: Both the Site key and the Secret key are needed for the captcha to work.

sessionSecret.title: SESSION_SECRET is strong (signs login sessions)
sessionSecret.fix: Set SESSION_SECRET to at least 32 random characters in .env (openssl rand -hex 32) and restart. Everyone logs in again.

encryptionKey.title: ENCRYPTION_KEY is valid (encrypts AI keys and the captcha secret)
encryptionKey.fix: Set ENCRYPTION_KEY = openssl rand -base64 32 in .env. Changing it makes stored API keys unreadable.

cookieSecure.title: Login cookie is sent over HTTPS only
cookieSecure.fix: Run with NODE_ENV=production and without COOKIE_SECURE=0.

keysHidden.title: AI API keys stay on the server (encrypted in the database, the browser sees a masked form)

admins.title: {n} active admin accounts
admins.fix: Keep few admin accounts; lock the ones not in use.

signupCaptcha.title: Public sign-up has a captcha
signupCaptcha.fix: Sign-up is open without a captcha: bots can create many accounts (especially with free credits). Turn on Turnstile below.

aiRate.title: AI calls per minute are limited
aiRate.fix: Set a per-minute limit so one account cannot burn the credits or the API.

aiDaily.title: Daily AI credits are limited
aiDaily.fix: Set the most credits in 24 hours to stop unusual use.

aiSize.title: The size of one AI request is limited
aiSize.fix: Set the most characters in and tokens out per call.

providers.title: {n} AI providers enabled
providers.fix: No AI provider is enabled: add one under Settings → AI.

failedLogins.title: {n} failed logins in 24 hours
failedLogins.fix: Many failed logins: check the list below, lock or change the password of the targeted account.

mail.title: Password reset e-mails can be sent
mail.fix: SMTP is not set up: users who forget their password cannot reset it themselves. Fill in the E-mail part below and save.

security.mailHint: Use your e-mail provider's SMTP: Gmail (turn on 2-step verification, then create an App Password), Zoho, Mailgun, Brevo… The site address is used for the links in e-mails.
security.testMail: Send a test e-mail to me

payments.title: Automatic payments with SePay
payments.hint: Learners pay by bank transfer with a QR code; SePay tells Gainee through a webhook and the credits are added at once, without approval. Switched off, top-ups are approved by hand under Top-ups.
payments.step1: Link the bank account above to SePay.
payments.step2: Webhooks → Add webhook: event "money in", send JSON to
payments.step3: Security: choose HMAC-SHA256 (recommended) or API Key, and paste the key below.
payments.step4: Company settings → Payment code structure: prefix {prefix}, suffix type "letters and digits", length 8 to 8. Change the prefix in both places; transfers made with an old code show under "SePay transfers to check".
payments.missing: Payments need the bank code, the account number and at least one webhook key.
payments.oddHint: Money arrived but no credits were added: too little, wrong content, or a request already closed. Check, then add credits by hand on the user's page.
payments.prefixExample: Codes look like {code} (8 random letters and digits)
payments.expireHint: 0 = never. Money arriving after that is still credited.

auth.point1: Turn articles and books into lessons with vocabulary and exercises
auth.point2: Review words just before you forget them, with spaced repetition
auth.point3: Dictation practice and IELTS tests like the real exam

landing.title: Read what you love. Remember words longer. Raise your IELTS band.
landing.lead: Gainee turns articles, books and videos into lessons with vocabulary, exercises, spaced review and IELTS practice, with AI explanations when you need them.
landing.bonus: {n} free AI credits when you sign up

demo.before: Scientists warn that the planet is warming at an
demo.after: rate, with summers growing longer every decade.

landing.featuresTitle: Everything for learning in one place
landing.featuresLead: Reading, listening, writing, review and test practice: you learn from real content, Gainee keeps it organised.

read.title: Reading into lessons
read.text: Paste an article or upload a PDF; AI splits it into short parts, picks vocabulary and writes IELTS-style questions.

words.title: Notebook & spaced review
words.text: Tap a word to look it up and save it; its card comes back right before you forget it.

ielts.title: IELTS practice tests
ielts.text: Listening and Reading tests like on the computer exam, scored, with your mistakes by question type.

listen.title: Dictation
listen.text: Hear sentences from videos and IELTS tests, type them, see exactly what you missed.

write.title: Writing graded by AI
write.text: Task 1, Task 2 and translation; get bands per criterion and fixes.

progress.title: See your progress
progress.text: Streaks, weekly goals, words you know and scores over time.

step1.title: Create an account
step1.text: Just an email; learn on your phone or computer.

step2.title: Pick something to read
step2.text: Study the texts in the library or add ones you like.

step3.title: A little every day
step3.text: 10–15 minutes of reading, listening and review; Gainee shows what is due.

landing.endText: It takes a minute to start.
